title: Autopilot Guided Trust Timeline
public_repo_rule: Public GitHub Pages may guide explicit source confirmation and rollback readiness, but the protected backend remains the only authority for source mutation and rollback execution.

uses_existing_routes.purpose: Run safe metadata-only autopilot queue and stop before source mutation.
Prepare a resumable backend-only source confirmation handoff.
Refresh rollback readiness before or after explicit source confirmation.

timeline_steps.label: Safe queue
timeline_steps.why: Autopilot may complete metadata-only safe steps automatically.

timeline_steps.label: Source gate
timeline_steps.why: Source mutation is prepared as a resumable protected backend handoff.

timeline_steps.label: Confirm source
timeline_steps.why: User must explicitly confirm backend-only source mutation.

timeline_steps.label: Rollback ready
timeline_steps.why: Rollback readiness refreshes without executing rollback.

timeline_steps.label: Undo path
timeline_steps.why: Undo is available only after backend execution and rollback preview.

scenarios.expected: A user can see safe queue, handoff, source confirmation, readiness and undo state in one panel.
The timeline exposes Confirm source change only when a backend handoff preview is ready.
Refresh rollback calls readiness only and does not execute source mutation or rollback.
Apply undo stays disabled until a protected rollback preview is available after source execution.
The timeline stores no raw chat text, document text, provider credentials or paid-route credentials.

next.why: After the guided timeline exists, add a deterministic browser fixture and visual QA pass for desktop/mobile interaction states.
